product_metadata.title: Bedsure Cotton Mattress Pad, Upgraded Thick Breathable Quilted Fitted Mattress Cover with Deep Pocket (8"-18"), Extra Soft Down Alternative Filled Mattress Topper (California King)
features: Premium Materials: The 300 TC cotton cover provides a breathable layer that keeps you from sweating and getting hot. Thick fill made from 100% microfiber offers soft support for your body and provides you a sound sleep.

Square Quilting Design: End-to-end box stitching keeps the fiber from shifting and makes the mattress protector more fluffy, which makes you feel like sleeping on a cloud. When you turn over at night, you won't be disturbed by the noise, you even won't feel any movement.

Fits 8"-18" Mattress: 15" skirt with a full-length elasticized bottom that goes all around is made to fit specialty size beds/mattresses up to 18" deep. Working like a fitted sheet, a deep pocket mattress pad keeps your pad in place without popping off the corners and allows sheets to fit properly.
Easy to Care: Machine washable in cold water with gentle cycle and tumble dry on low heat or air dry. But please do not iron.
Tips: This overfilled mattress pad is packed in a vacuum bag, open the package, and spread it for a few days or clean and dry it, it will back to the normal thickness and fluffy.
